feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated. The candidate is the iteration-5 design with two controller changes: kp 4.5 to 4.8 and kd 0.8 to 0.9. Geometry, ki 0.5, base_speed 1.3, sensor weights and line_loss are unchanged, so any difference in result comes from the gain change. The evidence is iteration 5 (score 606.2, best so far). Oval finished 20 of 20 (mean 1.98 s, steering_oscillation 0.243, well under the 0.35 caution level). S-bend finished 11 of 20 (progress 0.96, steering_oscillation 0.378). Slalom never finished (progress 0.44, 1.15 line-loss events per run), and it is the largest source of lost score. The step from kp 4.0/kd 0.6 to 4.5/0.8 in iteration 5 improved progress without breaking oval, so a further small step is a reasonable test. Note that the rationale's claim that kp 5 with kd 0.3 overshot refers to iteration 2, which had ki 0.02 and a different bias. It is a weaker comparison than the rationale implies, so treat kd as the main damping lever and watch steering_oscillation directly. Interpreting the next race: if oval stays at 20 of 20 with steering_oscillation below about 0.35, and s-bend or slalom progress rises above the iteration-5 values (0.96 and 0.44), keep kp 4.8 and kd 0.9. If oval completions drop, any oval run goes off track, or oval steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, return kp to 4.5 with kd 0.9. If s-bend steering_oscillation stays above 0.4 with kd 0.9, raise kd toward 1.0 before changing kp again. If slalom progress is flat but its max_error is near 0.06 m, slow response is still the limit, so the next step is a modest base_speed reduction only if completion_time has slack, not more kp.
requested_changes: If oval stays at 20 of 20 with steering_oscillation below about 0.35 and slalom or s-bend progress rises above iteration-5 values (0.44 and 0.96), keep controller.kp at 4.8 and controller.kd at 0.9, since iteration 5 showed oval oscillation of 0.243 at kp 4.5.

If any oval run goes off track or oval steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, set controller.kp back to 4.5 and keep controller.kd at 0.9, since the kp increase is then too aggressive for the oval bends.
If s-bend steering_oscillation stays above 0.4 with kd 0.9, raise controller.kd to about 1.0 before changing kp, since iteration 4 showed the highest s-bend oscillation (0.41) at kd 0.6.
